<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Dark Jedi Appears.

'''Card text:''' Use during a battle when at least one Dark Jedi is present. Use 1 Force to double the power of all other Imperial cards.

'''Lore:''' The presence of a Dark Lord raises the morale of Imperial rank-and-file soldiers, whether they like it or not. “You take command personally, Major.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese requires a Dark Jedi to be present, while the English specifies one of your Dark Jedi. The Japanese refers to other Imperial cards; the English refers to other Imperials there. The Japanese quotation uses the rank major, while the English uses commander.
